name: record_hospital_response
description: Record the hospital's answer. Call this exactly once: after the staff member has clearly said whether they can accept the patient now and has confirmed your read-back, or when they decline, give a different number to call, or the answer is still unclear after asking twice. Never record accepted unless they clearly agreed.

attempt_id.description: Internal attempt reference from the call context. It is filled in automatically; never ask for it and never say it.

outcome.description: One of: accepted, conditional, declined, redirected, unclear. Use conditional when they accept only with a condition.

bed_type.description: What they can offer right now. One of: icu_with_ventilator, icu, hdu, nicu, emergency_only, ward, none, unknown.

specialist_available.description: Whether the needed specialist is available now. One of: yes, on_call, no, unknown.

ready_in_minutes.description: Minutes until they are ready to receive the patient, as digits, for example 15. Leave empty if not said.

contact_person.description: Name or role the ambulance team should ask for, if they gave one.

conditions.description: Any condition attached to accepting, in a few words, for example: send the PHC case sheet with the patient.

decline_reason.description: Only if declined. One of: no_bed, no_ventilator, no_specialist, full, not_our_case, other, followed by a few words.

alternate_number.description: Only if redirected: the number they asked you to call, digits only, with country code if they said it.

to_number.description: The number you called. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
